title: Refactor cognitive complexity — CodeSearchService.cs (6 methods, range 16-41)
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
6 methods in `MemorySmith.App/Services/CodeSearchService.cs` exceed the cognitive complexity limit of 15:
- L1369 (41), L503 (38), L258 (33), L1260 (19), L3068 (17), L1701 (16)

## Impact
These methods are difficult to understand, test, and maintain. CodeSearchService.cs has 62 issues total and is one of the two most problematic files.

## Action Required
Decompose each method: extract query-building, indexing, and search phases into separate methods. Use guard clauses and early returns to reduce nesting.

## Effort
~36min

## Priority
P1 — Maintainability
